suppress.notes: CVE-2021-43138 is prototype pollution in the npm package "async" (cpe:2.3:a:async_project:async). AsyncFixer is a Roslyn analyzer. Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces is the .NET reference assembly for IAsyncEnumerable. Neither is the npm library. The assembly version (1.0.0, 2.1.0, 3.1.0, 1.1.0) was used as the npm package version.
CVE-2006-2453 is a buffer overflow in the Dia diagram editor. Dia2Lib.dll shipped in Microsoft.Diagnostics.Tracing.TraceEvent is the Microsoft Debug Interface Access COM interop assembly, not Dia.

GitVersion.MsBuild is an MSBuild task. Dependency-Check bound the PackageReference (version 6.*) to the Git binary, including a CPE whose target is Ruby (cpe:2.3:a:git:git:*:*:*:*:*:ruby:*:* and cpe:2.3:a:git_project:git). CVE-2024-32002 and the other hits are vulnerabilities in git itself. A vulnerable git on the runner is the runner image, not this package.

IronPython is the .NET Python implementation. The DLL was bound to CPython (cpe:2.3:a:python:python:3.4.2); the representative hits CVE-2020-27619 (ctypes) and CVE-2016-5636 (zipimporter) are in that interpreter. The nuspec was bound to cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:python:3.4.2, which is Python for Windows and the VS Code Python extension: CVE-2020-17163 is the Windows installer, and CVE-2024-49050 / CVE-2025-49714 are the extension (fixed in 2024.18.2 and 2025.8.1). None of those products is the IronPython NuGet package.

LibGit2Sharp.dll 0.31.0 was given cpe:2.3:a:libgit2:libgit2:0.31.0. That is the managed assembly version, not the native library. LibGit2Sharp 0.31.0 (2024-12-03) ships libgit2 1.8.4. CVE-2024-24577 is fixed in libgit2 1.6.5 and 1.7.2. Re-check the bundled native version when bumping LibGit2Sharp; a native binary identified as libgit2 itself is not covered by this rule.

Microsoft.CSharp.dll in the 4.7.0 package reports assembly version 3.1.0, which was bound to cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:.net_core:3.1, the whole .NET Core 3.1 runtime. The file is the C# runtime-binder reference assembly. The attached CVEs are in other components (CVE-2020-0605 WCF, CVE-2021-26701 System.Text.Encodings.Web, CVE-2022-41032 NuGet).

CVE-2026-69805 is an NVD version-range error on a real product CPE. Microsoft's advisory lists Microsoft.Diagnostics.Runtime as affected at exactly 4.1.740301, plus Visual Studio 17.14.0-17.14.40 and 18.9.0-18.9.3. NVD encoded that as "all versions up to (excluding) 4.1.740301", which pulled in the 3.1.512801 assembly this repo actually restores. The CPE stays live: restoring 4.1.740301 still fails the build.

CVE-2023-4914 is path traversal in cecilapp/cecil, a PHP static site generator, before 7.47.1 (cpe:2.3:a:cecil:cecil). Mono.Cecil.Mdb.dll is the Mono symbol reader inside Mono.Cecil, the .NET IL library bundled by coverlet and ILLink. The same files were also given cpe:2.3:a:mono-project:mono_framework, which is the Mono runtime, not this library.

NUnit.Extension.TeamCityEventListener writes TeamCity service messages from an NUnit test run. It is not the TeamCity server. cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:teamcity:1.0.10 attached the server's CVE list (264 on the 2026-10-12 scan, including the CVE-2024-27198 authentication bypass) because the package version is 1.0.10.

CVE-2024-47911 is blind SQL injection in the SonarQube Server authorizations/group-memberships API, versions 10.4 up to 10.6. SonarAnalyzer.CSharp.dll 10.5.0.109200 is the Roslyn analyzer NuGet. The version string shares a 10.5 prefix with SonarQube Server and was bound to cpe:2.3:a:sonarsource:sonarqube. The analyzer does not host that API.

cpe:2.3:a:tasks:tasks is the Tasks.org Android app (CVE-2020-22475, CVE-2022-39349). It was applied to System.Threading.Tasks, System.Threading.Tasks.Extensions, ILLink.Tasks, and the CommandLineParser nuspec because the file or package name contains "Tasks" and the version number collided.
CVE-2015-0897 is a TLS mistake in the LINE messenger apps for Android and iOS. CommandLine.dll is the CommandLineParser assembly; its product name was bound to cpe:2.3:a:line:line.

Nuspec package URLs were bound to cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:nuget at the package's own version (CVE-2022-41064, a .NET Framework information disclosure, and CVE-2022-30184). These packages are not the NuGet client. NETStandard.Library was also bound to cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:project_standard, which is Microsoft Project Standard, not the .NET targeting pack. A package whose id is NuGet is not covered here.

CVE-2001-0152 is the password file written by Compressed Folders in Microsoft Plus! for Windows 98 and Windows Me (cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:plus). System.Private.Windows.GdiPlus.dll is the GDI+ wrapper inside System.Drawing.Common. The product name "Plus" was taken from "GdiPlus".

CodeCoverage.exe, covrun*.dll, and MicrosoftInstrumentationEngine_*.dll ship inside the Microsoft.CodeCoverage test package. Their file versions were read as Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code versions (cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:visual_studio and :visual_studio_code). They are not a Visual Studio install. msdia140.dll is handled on its own, below, because that file really is a DIA redistributable.

CVE-2014-3802 is an unchecked variable in msdia.dll as shipped in Visual Studio before 2013. The copies here are msdia140.dll (DIA 14) with file versions 14.36 and 14.51, redistributed by TraceEvent, Microsoft.TestPlatform.TestHost, and Microsoft.CodeCoverage. The CPE is not suppressed: a later advisory that names this file can still match visual_studio.
